answer: Reputation is a scarce, unforgeable resource earned by consistently passing originality checks, and the economy spends it to filter out Sybil clusters before they can compound into a majority. This is why the network can stay open without a central gatekeeper: the economics of reputation do the filtering that a trusted authority otherwise would.. The reason this works is that the attacker must pay a real cost on every identity, so scale becomes a liability rather than an advantage. A shale stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a meadow holds the reputation that makes it all...
